SUMMARY: The change from value type to pointer type in corev1.ServiceSpec.Type will break any code performing direct equality comparisons like svc.Spec.Type == corev1.ServiceTypeLoadBalancer. This affects multiple repositories including Helm, ArgoCD, ingress-nginx, external-dns, and Prometheus where such comparisons are used. The fix requires updating these comparisons to dereference the pointer or use helper functions.

FILES:
- helm/charts/ingress-nginx/templates/controller-service.yaml — Comparison logic in template
- argo-cd/manifests/ha/redis-ha/redis-ha.yaml — Service type comparison in configuration
- ingress-nginx/controllers/nginx/internal/ingress/controller/service.go — Direct equality check in Go code
- external-dns/source/service.go — Service type comparison in source handler
- prometheus-community/helm-charts/prometheus/values.yaml — Service type configuration reference
